title: Record decision
intro: Choose one outcome. Your decision is recorded with your name, role, facility and time, and cannot be edited after it is saved.

no_further_action.label: Record assessment — no further action
no_further_action.description: Record your assessment note. No referral or task is created.

refer.label: Refer
refer.description: Create a referral to a facility you choose, with a reason and a due date.

request_repeat_screening.label: Request repeat test
request_repeat_screening.description: Create a repeat-test task for a community health worker of this facility.

plan_follow_up.label: Plan follow-up review
plan_follow_up.description: Create a planned review task with a due date you set.

dismiss.label: Dismiss flag with reason
dismiss.description: Close the flag with a reason. Nothing else is created.

fields.dueAtHint: Set by you — no interval is pre-filled. Africa/Kigali time.
fields.workersLoading: Loading the health workers of this facility…
fields.workersEmpty: No authorised community health worker in this facility.
fields.workersHint: Only authorised community health workers of the active facility are listed.

confirm.title: Confirm decision
confirm.description: Check the summary. The decision is saved once and cannot be edited afterwards.

summary.createsPlannedFor: A planned review task assigned to {{worker}}
summary.createsNothing: Nothing else — no referral or task

success.title: Decision recorded
success.toastBody: The review queue has been updated.
success.replayed: This decision had already been saved — it was not submitted twice.
success.alreadyTitle: This review already has a decision
success.alreadyBody: Decisions cannot be edited. The recorded decision is shown read-only.
success.nothingCreated: No referral or task was created.
success.noNextCase: No other pending case in this queue view.

draft.restoreBody: A decision draft for this review was saved on this browser and not submitted.
draft.offlineSaved: Saved as draft on this browser
draft.offlineBody: Simulated offline — the decision cannot be saved right now. Your draft is kept.

guard.notStarted: Start the review before recording a decision
guard.notStartedBody: A decision can only be recorded from a review you have started.
guard.otherReviewer: This review is in review by {{name}}
guard.otherReviewerBody: Only the clinician reviewing the case can record the decision.

conflict.title: This review changed since you opened it
conflict.description: Nothing was saved or overwritten. Reload the latest version, or discard your draft.
conflict.referralOpen: An open referral already exists for this review. Nothing was saved.

errors.alreadyDecided: A decision was already recorded for this review (for example in another tab). Nothing was overwritten.
errors.notSavedBody: Your values are kept. Retry sends the same request again, so the decision cannot be saved twice.
errors.workerNotAuthorised: This health worker is not authorised for this facility.

evidence.title: Evidence summary
evidence.subtitle: Read-only, from the flag-time snapshot
evidence.unavailable: The evidence snapshot is not available.
